Climate only: the real-species plant lists were removed, because this game uses its own invented plant families (docs/DESIGN.md §C). climate.temp_c is mean annual °C; moisture is 0 (bone dry) to 1 (waterlogged); altitude_m where given.
name: Tundra
notes: Arctic lowland tundra: treeless, permafrost, dominated by mosses, lichens, sedges, dwarf willows and heath shrubs. Drawn on Alaska/Canada, Siberia and Scandinavian Arctic.
